title: Articles by Country Search, All Articles - Emerging Infectious Diseases journal - CDC
content: Emerging Infectious Disease journal ISSN: 1080-6059 Articles by Country Search Browse journal articles by the topic country or territory. Click here to review map features and guidelines. Data: Articles are tagged with keywords in the database. Usually, the keywords include the countries or territories where the disease was found. This page presents data on these countries as they were recorded in the database. Map: The map presents the number of times a country was tagged as a keyword within the specified date range. To view the articles, click on a country to go to its summary page. Table: The table presents the same data as the map, but in tabular form. Countries or territories with no article data in the specified date range are omitted from the table. Click on a country name to go to its summary page. Accuracy: There may be inaccuracies because of how keywords were assigned or when duplicate locations share the same names (e.g. Georgia shows results for both the country and the U.S. state). Disclaimer: We do not guarantee the accuracy of maps or data with regard to borders, names, or other aspects of countries or territories. The map views generated and associated data are not intended to provide any documentation or evidence related to disease incidence.
